name: Terra Dining
address: 91 Jalan Aminuddin Baki, Taman Tun Dr Ismail, 60000, Kuala Lumpur
dinnerNote: Inert.ia tasting menu, priced ++ (service charge and tax on top); wagyu main RM200 extra
dinnerNoteMs: Menu rasa Inert.ia, harga ++ (caj perkhidmatan dan cukai ditambah); hidangan utama wagyu tambahan RM200

menus.name: Inert.ia tasting menu
menus.note: Priced ++ (service charge and tax on top). Choice of duck or wagyu main (wagyu RM200 extra), chosen when booking. Five-glass wine pairing RM298, three glasses RM198, champagne and wine pairing RM428, zero-proof tea pairing RM268. A vegetarian menu at the same price needs two working days' notice.

bookingOpens: Online on SevenRooms, or by WhatsApp or email to reservations@terra-dining.com. A deposit of RM150 a guest, paid by Visa or Mastercard (not Amex), confirms the booking. Dinner Tuesday to Saturday, with tables from 6pm to 8.30pm.
cancellation: Cancel at least 48 hours ahead. Later cancellations, date changes after that point, fewer guests and no-shows are charged RM150 a guest.
groups: For five or more guests, contact the restaurant by WhatsApp or email.
dressCode: Smart casual, though guests are encouraged to dress up.
children: Children aged 7 and over are welcome and have the same tasting menu as the rest of the table.
duration: About two and a half hours.
byob: Guests may bring their own wine if they buy one bottle from the list for each bottle brought; spirits corkage is RM300 a bottle.
